h: Korach Shmuel and the Desire for Spiritual Rank

p: and the connection to this parsha,
מַה שֶּׁאָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל (שְׁמוּאֵל א יב, ג)
which resembles the language of Moshe Rabbeinu
לֹא חֲמוֹר אֶחָד מֵהֶם נָשָׂאתִי וְגוֹמֵר
"Not one donkey of theirs have I taken, etc."
And so too what is expounded in Midrash Rabbah,
the pesukim of Shmuel and the pesukim of Moshe,
that Shmuel renewed the kingship for Shaul,
he spoke words of rebuke to them,
which you have done in the eyes of Hashem,
to ask for yourselves a king."
And so the matter of Korach:
לֹא רַק עַל כְּהוּנַּת אַהֲרֹן בִּלְבַד
not only the Kehunah of Aharon alone,
only they did not go before them
they went out to battle and were victorious.
And this is what it says (ibid. 12:17):
"Is it not the wheat harvest today?
I will call to Hashem, etc.";
who took them out of Mitzrayim
and sustained and provided for them in the wilderness
with the man and the well;
but the aspect of a king
for the Sages are called kings,
in the manner of all the nations,
who would go out before them to battle.
as they said in Midrash Rabbah
כִּי לֹא אוֹיֵב יְחָרְפֵנִי (שָׁם נה, יג)
'For it is not an enemy who reviles me' (ibid. 55:13)
that he had superiority in stature
but only that Hashem Yisbarach chose him;
and had Hashem Yisbarach chosen another,
that is, through their own efforts;
only from the side of Hashem Yisbarach.
it expounded this pasuk about Aharon,
for the Midrash did not want
since it is explicit in the Torah (Devarim 34:10):
therefore it expounded it about Aharon.
that he would be kohen and king.
And in Midrash Rabbah it is stated
אֵלֶּה שְׁנֵי בְנֵי הַיִּצְהָר וְגוֹמֵר (זְכַרְיָה ד, יד)
"'These are the two sons of oil, etc.' (Zechariah 4:14):
Rather, this is Aharon and David,
and made kohen and king? etc."
and to dispute the kingship of Moshe.
And this is what it says (Bamidbar 16:2):
which refers to Korach, Dasan and Aviram,
for Korach, and likewise Dasan and Aviram,
these are the two hundred and fifty men;
and this is why it says
"the two sons of oil" is expounded
(שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה טו, טו, ג)
"the two sons of oil" is expounded
as the merit of Moshe and of Aharon,
even though Moshe was not anointed.
"And let oil not be lacking on your head":
are the sum of the words of Torah,
brought down all the words of Torah,
and the parshiyos of tefillin among them;

p: And in Midrash Rabbah it is stated about this
'It is too much for you; do not continue, etc.'"
for the good of Klal Yisrael,
אֶעְבְּרָה נָּא וְאֶרְאֶה וְגוֹמֵר (דְּבָרִים ג, כה)
"Let me cross over, please, and see, etc." (Devarim 3:25);
that this level is higher than you;
even though he did not come with force
And one may learn from this
that even for levels in holiness
and one should not pray for this;
for the help of Hashem Yisbarach,
that he be able to prevail
"Were it not that Hakadosh Baruch Hu
in the manner of what they said
to be a vessel for Torah";
כְּשֶׁבָּרָא אֶת הָאָדָם יָשָׁר (קֹהֶלֶת ז, כט)
בְּזֵעַת אַפְּךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג, יט)
"By the sweat of your brow shall you eat bread" (Bereishis 3:19)
(and this was explained well in Parshas Lech Lecha).
such as to attain ruach hakodesh
for this it is not fitting to pray;
for if it is His will, Yisbarach,
He will give it to him;
since it was not His will, Yisbarach,
that he attain the holiness of the Land,
had answered the sons of Levi.
And in the Midrash on this parsha
what did he see in this folly?
and that to him were fitting
the Crown of Kingship and the Crown of Kehunah.

p: Further it is stated in Midrash Rabbah
שִׁמְעוּ נָא בְּנֵי לֵוִי (בְּמִדְבַּר טז, ח)
it would have been more fitting
are called by the name of Yosef,
And this is why he took as the example
even though in the tribe of Shimon
who died over the matter of Pe'or,
and this is the meaning of
the example would have been more fitting:
that in the holy Zohar it is stated
the peace of above and below;
and Shabbos too is called peace,
and it is the Name of Hakadosh Baruch Hu.
the Midrash Rabbah took the example
was in the aspect of a tzaddik,
and a chariot for the attribute of
to merit the Crown of Kehunah of Aharon
and the Crown of Kingship of Moshe.
was equal to Moshe and Aharon,
and in this his eye misled him,
And this is the connection of the haftarah
that they are of one matter at the root.
